test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b87e4fae023cc5fad548e1d36244343a3ca9f773c6ba6d550d5f53f21a71a7d2.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +2, -4.

Let’s check each option:

1. LS – JO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c959f2a6aab398658f29a521d178272f2e8eff0a1a50ce3983481cbd1b699ed.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +2, -4.

2. DM – FI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d4d2788fa461b8c8a506b6dc8aeba3e4418e3e6e79b16d5133be8e3831b1c46.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +2, -4.

3. KP – ML

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb08df3163228c066d52b706f979d22ebd209bf5d6c43d32afe3865d7479383.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +2, -4.

4. RJ – TF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63d52dbe02713a96380abf5812cfeda022076bbe5f144cfa845d4fdee3f21505.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +2, -4. 

Thus, LS – JO is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
